profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Platform Engineering | Driving Product Growth Through Scalable Architecture
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Full Stack Web Developer with experience in Client Services and HR. In my spare time, I enjoy playing sports and keeping myself active as it attributes to my team-player mentality. My work expresses my dedication and defines my work ethic with every project I take on. My passion and creativity to this industry are key to my overall success and set the standard for which I hold myself responsible.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Transformed the Typescript/React web platform by architecting a dynamic form journey system, enhancing user engagement.  
• Directed non-core product initiatives, establishing architectural direction and engineering standards across teams.  
• Scaled the Rails platform document generation system to support evolving product and compliance requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and bootstrapped a TypeScript/React web client, enhancing frontend architecture for improved performance.  
• Modernized state management by migrating from Redux to Redux Toolkit, establishing a long-term technical direction.  
• Defined TypeScript interfaces aligned with our Rails GraphQL API schema, ensuring type safety for all client queries and mutations.  
• Implemented observability and logging with New Relic, facilitating production monitoring and faster issue detection.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and launched a production React and TypeScript frontend integrated with a Rails REST API, achieving MVP status within one quarter.  
• Established frontend engineering standards, enhancing consistency and maintainability across the engineering team.  
• Contributed to multiple financial products, guiding technical direction and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Architected and delivered a 14-page banking website featuring complex animations and transitions using GSAP.  
• Achieved a 200% increase in user growth within the first month post-launch.  
• Maintained a 97 Lighthouse SEO score while balancing performance and visual complexity.  
• Designed a modular frontend architecture recognized by senior leadership for its long-term maintainability.

positions.title: Language Resources Intern - Client Services
positions.description:
Ensured the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to client needs and objectives.

Operated as the lead point of contact for any and all matters specific to my assigned accounts.

Supported active accounts through attending conference calls and presentations.

Built and maintained strong, long-lasting relationships while working with clients to ensure effective on-boarding, user adoption, retention and overall success.

Helped the department manager with hands-on management of daily activities for current accounts.

Collaborated in communicating clients' needs and feedback throughout the company.

positions.title: HR and Recruiting Intern
positions.description:
Assisted  the  HR  Director  in  the  preparation,  collection,  and  organization  of paperwork  to  properly  onboard  new  employees. 

Coordinated  interviews  with  hiring  managers  and  prospective  employees. 

Conducted  interviews  for  interns. 

Created  exit  interviews  for  resigning  employees. 

Used  recruiting  tools  to  create  boolean  searches  for  open  positions. 

Hosted  phone  interviews  for  applied  candidates. 

Built  a  Human  Resources  intranet  for  the  use  of  all  employees  and  hiring managers  and  maintained  the  database  of  available  resources.
